Your first query in Resource Graph Explorer
The limits nobody warns you about

takeaways: Azure Resource Graph is a free, already-enabled service that answers one question across all subscriptions you can read, and it powers parts of the Azure portal.
A small slice of KQL (where, summarize count, project, order by, extend) is enough to inventory, filter and group your Azure estate in Resource Graph Explorer.
Know the limits: results default to one thousand records with paging, queries time out after thirty seconds, and you only see resources you have read access to.
hook: Clicking through the Azure portal stops working once you have thousands of resources across many subscriptions. This beginner-friendly episode explains Azure Resource Graph, its KQL basics and its limits, so admins and cloud newcomers can inventory and govern their whole estate with a single query.
